name: KLEJ
description: A comprehensive multi-task benchmark for Polish language understanding, covering diverse tasks such as named entity recognition, question answering, textual entailment, and sentiment analysis, with an online leaderboard.
evaluation_method: accuracy / F1 / exact match depending on the subtask
reputation: Widely used as a standard Polish NLP benchmark and leaderboard for evaluating multi-task language understanding models.
notes: Includes a new sentiment analysis task for e-commerce domain; promotes models generalizing across multiple NLU tasks.
